## Topic guide

### PK/PD Modeling {#pkpd}

Models of drug exposure and response, from compartmental kinetics to pharmacodynamic relationships. Start with the [one-compartment intravenous bolus notebook](notebooks/pkpd/one-compartment-pk.qmd).

### Population Pharmacokinetics {#poppk}

Population models, between-individual variability, covariates, and parameter estimation. No notebooks published in this topic yet.

### PBPK Modeling {#pbpk}

Physiologically based descriptions of absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion. No notebooks published in this topic yet.

### Quantitative Systems Pharmacology {#qsp}

Mechanistic models linking biological pathways, drug effects, and disease dynamics. No notebooks published in this topic yet.

### Simulation & Computational Tools {#simulation}

Numerical methods, simulation design, and reproducible workflows in R, Julia, and Python. No notebooks published in this topic yet.
